heroSubtitle: The 2010 agreement, the investment, the dispute, and more than eleven years seeking enforcement.
overviewDescription: The case centers on a lease-to-own agreement, the investment made to transform the property, and the dispute that followed when Leo and Olga sought to exercise their contractual option to purchase.

timeline.title: Lease-to-Own Agreement
timeline.description: Leo and Olga entered into a lease-to-own agreement concerning the commercial property in Delray Beach, Florida.

timeline.title: Investment and Transformation
timeline.description: They invested their life savings, professional expertise, and substantial effort into rebuilding and operating the property as a family business.

timeline.title: Purchase Dispute and Lawsuit
timeline.description: After they say they exercised their contractual option to purchase the property, a dispute developed over enforcement of the agreement. Leo and Olga filed suit in Florida on October 30, 2014.

timeline.title: Prolonged Litigation
timeline.description: The dispute continued through more than eleven years of litigation as Leo and Olga pursued enforcement of the agreement and related claims.

timeline.title: Related Litigation
timeline.description: Additional litigation and legal proceedings became part of the continuing dispute.

timeline.title: Judicial Recusal
timeline.description: A judicial recusal became another development in the continuing legal proceedings.

timeline.title: Continuing Legal Effort
timeline.description: Leo and Olga continue seeking focused legal representation and support for the claims described in the public record.

contractParagraphs.text: Leo and Olga say that they followed the terms of their lease-to-own agreement and invested substantial personal resources into the property with the expectation that they could ultimately purchase it.
After the dispute over the purchase of the property arose, they chose to pursue legal enforcement of the agreement through the Florida courts.
The campaign seeks support for experienced national legal representation as they continue pursuing the claims described in the public record.
The legal history is documented through the campaign's public materials, including the case record, photographs, videos, and campaign updates.

whyText: Beyond the circumstances of one property dispute, the case raises a broader question about what happens when a written agreement is challenged after one party has invested years of work, money, and effort in reliance on that agreement.
evidenceDescription: Explore the campaign's videos, photographs, documents, and other materials that help document the history of the property and the legal dispute.
